title: Plain-language interface copy
summary: Apply the ISO 24495-1 plain-language principles to the launcher's catalog wording: a rule document, a review prompt with rewrite and cold-read passes, rewritten messages, and a guard that holds hints to one line.

included: The rewrite and cold-read prompt in the lumilio-i18n skill
Rewriting zh-CN messages and the English written from them
A catalog guard for hint length
User guide sections that receive details moved out of a message
excluded: Game logs, content-source text and plugin-owned words
New UI surfaces for supplementary details, such as a link from the launcher to the guide; a message that needs one is listed for a separate decision
Reproducing the text of the standard

tasks.title: Write the rules
tasks.acceptance: docs/plain-language.md cites ISO 24495-1 clauses without quoting the standard. Design language §8, design-patterns.md, AGENTS.md and the lumilio-i18n and lumilio-motion-design skills point to it. just docs passes.

tasks.title: Write the review prompt
tasks.acceptance: plain-review-prompt.md defines a rewrite pass that returns per-message proposals without editing files, and a cold read that uses only the words on a screen.

tasks.title: Revise the first batch
tasks.acceptance: The 20 longest Chinese messages have rewrite proposals and cold-read results. The Project Maintainer reviews them; accepted Chinese and the English written from it are in the catalogs; the lumilio-ui i18n and English tests pass; screenshots of changed surfaces are reviewed in both languages.

tasks.title: Guard hint length
tasks.acceptance: A lumilio-ui test fails with the message id when a hint (an id ending in -help or -note) is longer than one sentence of 20 characters, or its English is more than twice as wide. long-hints.txt lists the hints not revised yet and may only shrink. A demonstrated failing case is recorded.

tasks.title: Revise the remaining sections
tasks.acceptance: Every catalog section passes a rewrite and cold-read pass, dialog intros and bodies meet their plain-language §6 limits, and long-hints.txt is empty.

validation.criterion: The rules and pointers are in place and just docs passes.
First-batch proposals and cold-read results are reviewed by the Project Maintainer.
validation.result: 2026-10-23: the Project Maintainer accepted the recut batch after the first proposals were rejected as too long.

validation.criterion: Changed surfaces are reviewed in screenshots in Chinese and in English at the 720 px window.
The guard fails on a new over-limit message and passes on listed ones.
validation.result: 2026-10-23: without long-hints.txt, hints_fit_one_line failed and named the 67 hints not revised yet; with the list it passes. No message of the revised batch is in the list.

decisions.decision: Keep the rules in docs/plain-language.md, beside the design language.
decisions.rationale: The Project Maintainer chose a separate document. Design language §8 keeps voice and form; the new document covers content and order.
decisions.consequences: §8 links to it. A rule change updates the document in the same change.

decisions.decision: Cite ISO 24495-1 by clause and write the rules in our own words.
decisions.consequences: The standard is not quoted or committed.

decisions.decision: Length limits come from the space of each place a message appears, and they are hard.
decisions.rationale: A ⓘ hint is a tooltip that never wraps, so a long hint runs past the window. The standard measures plain language by whether readers can use the words, so fitting a limit is necessary but not sufficient.
decisions.consequences: Facts that do not fit move to a key's own tooltip or the documentation. The cold read and screenshot review still decide whether a message works.

decisions.decision: Rewrite and evaluation run in separate agents: the rewrite pass may read the code, the cold read sees only the screen's words.
decisions.rationale: An author who knows the mechanism writes it into the copy; a reader without that context shows what the words alone convey.
decisions.consequences: Agents propose and do not edit. The main session applies changes after the Project Maintainer's review.

decisions.decision: Facts moved out of a message go to the user guide, except a fact needed to finish the action on that screen.
decisions.rationale: The launcher has no link to the guide. What data goes to which service must stay findable [5.2.5], but the command variable names are needed to write a command.
decisions.consequences: Translation services are on the content sources page and the diagnostics contents on a diagnostics page. The command dialogs keep a line of environment variable names, without $ or %, so it reads right on every system. A link from a message to the guide is a separate decision.

decisions.decision: A hint is named by its id: -help or -note. The guard measures messages by that name.
decisions.rationale: The name is the one mark of where a message appears that a catalog test can read without parsing call sites.
decisions.consequences: A ⓘ, a key's tooltip, a line under a field and an empty state's line use these endings. A new long hint fails the test; long-hints.txt only shrinks. Per-key tooltips replace an ⓘ that explains several keys (design language §9).

lessonsLearned: The first proposals kept 60–140 character help texts. The limits had been taken from the catalog's own length distribution, privacy text was allowed past them, and cold-read questions were answered by adding sentences. Settings help is a ⓘ tooltip that never wraps. Guard: plain-language §6 sets limits from each place's space, §3 and §7 stop questions from adding sentences, and hints_fit_one_line tests every hint.
